subject: Demo: NovaRetail inference platform - scheduling / update
messages:
From: Sarah Chen <schen@novaretail.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Intro + demo request

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We've got a small initiative to evaluate inference options for our storefront personalization pipeline and I'd like to get a demo of Redwood's inference platform for the team.

Currently available windows: Tue 2/24 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 2/25 14:00-15:00 PT. Can you do one of those?

Attendees from our side: me (Head of ML) and Tom Alvarez (Eng Lead).

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Chen
Head of ML, NovaRetail

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chen <schen@novaretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request

Hi Sarah — great to hear. Wed 2/25 14:00 PT works for me and Ben (copying). I attached a short demo deck so you and Tom can share internally if helpful.

Proposed agenda (30 min):
- Quick context & use cases (5)
- Live demo: inference latency, cost controls, routing (15)
- Q&A + next steps (10)

I'll send a calendar invite for Wed 2/25 14:00 PT. If you prefer Tue we can switch.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.wiki/redwood-demo

Attachment: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (PDF, 3 slides)

From: Sarah Chen <schen@novaretail.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-24T09:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request

Hi Logan — heads up: Tom is traveling all next week and the eng lead who would be most involved is out of office until 3/3. Can we move the demo to the week of 3/8? Sorry for the churn — travel schedule changed last minute.

Thanks,
Sarah

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chen <schen@novaretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-24T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request

Thanks Sarah — no problem, I can move it. Would March 9 or March 10 work for you and Tom?

If it's helpful I can also do a short 15-minute sync with Tom only to cover the technical checklist ahead of the team demo.

Agree to keep the calendar flexible.

Best,
Logan

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novaretail.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-28T15:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request

Hi Logan,

Quick update from our side: leadership is shifting priorities this quarter and the storefront personalization infra project is deprioritized for at least the next 2-3 months. Given that, we don't need to schedule a demo right now. Apologies — we had hoped to move faster but the roadmap changed.

We'll reach out when this comes back up. Please keep us on any product updates you think are relevant (latency/cost improvements or marketplace integrations).

Thanks,
Tom Alvarez
Engineering Lead, NovaRetail

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novaretail.com>, Sarah Chen <schen@novaretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-28T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request

Thanks for the update Tom — totally understood and thanks for the transparency. I appreciate you flagging the roadmap change.

A couple quick things from our side:
- We'll leave the deck we shared open and send a brief note in ~8 weeks to check timing.
- If helpful, I can provide a short ROI note (expected latency/cost delta for a 10M monthly inference token workload) you can keep with your internal materials.

If anything changes sooner, please ping me directly.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
Internal note: looping Ben and Marissa for visibility — update CRM and set cadence to re-touch in ~8 weeks.
